comments.text: People don't realize that 'GREEDWILL STORE' is a franchise owned by a single person back east. I used to shop at 'GREEDWILL STORES' years ago when the workers decided what they needed to charge for the item. I personally knew over 50 of the managers here in Southern California and they would ask me what I would charge for certain items. As I was involved in antiques and collectibles I would tell them what to charge so other dealers could buy the items and still make a profit. When the owners of the franchise started getting 'GREEDY ' they made a booklet that told the stores what to charge for the item. It got to a point where management told the stores what they were expected to make each week. If they didn't make the money after a couple of weeks they were fired. They were required to send to the main office anything that might be of value where they had so called experts would put the the items on the Internet. If anything was junk they would send it to a store to sell. When we still had .99 cent stores they would send the employees to buy items for .99 cents and mark up the price to $2.99 to fill the shelves. There are three franchises located in my area. I'm not sure how many stores they have anymore since I stopped shopping at 'GREEDWILL STORES'. The largest had around 200 stores. The other two had less stores.  Several years ago I was in a 'GREEDWILL STORE' and they have signs saying how they help veterans. While I was in the store a Veteran came in asking if they could help him with getting a suit as he had a job interview the following day. When the manager came out he told the Veteran 'What do you think we are? Some kind of charity.' Needles to say the Veteran left empty handed. As a Proud Viet Nam Era Veteran 🇺🇲🕊️🗽 I use the local VA for my medical needs. I decided to ask other veterans if they have ever been helped by 'GREEDWILL STORES'. Not one person said they have. I stopped by a 'GREEDWILL STORE' location yesterday. There was not a single item priced under $4.99.  Not only that the store really smelled bad and needed a cleaning. I probably could go on with my experience. I'm sure many people have had the same.
